tool_input.command:
WAREHOUSE_ID="4dfab06c923fe3cc"
SQL='CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab0d6714.scaled7ecfaf
USING DELTA
TBLPROPERTIES (
  '"'"'delta.columnMapping.mode'"'"' = '"'"'name'"'"',
  '"'"'feature_store_version'"'"' = '"'"'1'"'"'
)
AS
WITH train_raw AS (
  SELECT row_id,
    CAST(f1 AS DOUBLE) AS f1, CAST(f2 AS DOUBLE) AS f2,
    CAST(f3 AS DOUBLE) AS f3, CAST(f4 AS DOUBLE) AS f4
  FROM read_files(
    '"'"'/Volumes/workspace/mlpab0d6714/data_upload/features_train.csv'"'"',
    format => '"'"'csv'"'"', header => true, inferSchema => true
  )
),
serve_raw AS (
  SELECT row_id,
    CAST(f1 AS DOUBLE) AS f1, CAST(f2 AS DOUBLE) AS f2,
    CAST(f3 AS DOUBLE) AS f3, CAST(f4 AS DOUBLE) AS f4
  FROM read_files(
    '"'"'/Volumes/workspace/mlpab0d6714/data_upload/features_serve.csv'"'"',
    format => '"'"'csv'"'"', header => true, inferSchema => true
  )
),
train_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(f1) AS mean_f1, STDDEV_POP(f1) AS std_f1,
    AVG(f2) AS mean_f2, STDDEV_POP(f2) AS std_f2,
    AVG(f3) AS mean_f3, STDDEV_POP(f3) AS std_f3,
    AVG(f4) AS mean_f4, STDDEV_POP(f4) AS std_f4
  FROM train_raw
),
all_raw AS (
  SELECT row_id, f1, f2, f3, f4, '"'"'train'"'"' AS split FROM train_raw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, f1, f2, f3, f4, '"'"'serve'"'"' AS split FROM serve_raw
)
SELECT
  a.row_id,
  a.split,
  ROUND((a.f1 - s.mean_f1) / s.std_f1, 6) AS f1,
  ROUND((a.f2 - s.mean_f2) / s.std_f2, 6) AS f2,
  ROUND((a.f3 - s.mean_f3) / s.std_f3, 6) AS f3,
  ROUND((a.f4 - s.mean_f4) / s.std_f4, 6) AS f4
FROM all_raw a
CROSS JOIN train_stats s'

databricks api post /api/2.0/sql/statements -o json \
  --json "{\"statement\": $(echo "$SQL" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))'), \"warehouse_id\": \"$WAREHOUSE_ID\", \"wait_timeout\": \"120s\"}" 2>&1
